build_IPUBaseRunner: build an IPUBaseRunner instance wrapping a PyTorch model with IPU compilation options and fp16 config
run_IPUBaseRunner: run the IPUBaseRunner with IPUDataLoader instances and a workflow list for training or validation
register_lr_hook_IPUBaseRunner: register a learning rate updater hook on IPUBaseRunner using a policy config dict
register_optimizer_hook_IPUBaseRunner: register an optimizer hook on IPUBaseRunner using an optimizer config dict or IPUFp16OptimizerHook instance
build_IPUEpochBasedRunner: build an IPUEpochBasedRunner to train a model epoch by epoch on IPU hardware with IPU options
